_doc: Requested components of a DeepSeek V4.1 decode step, as sums of analyze_step_timing.py categories. 'markers' are the start-marker names (from instrumentation.diff) inside the component, used for the per-marker overhead correction. Categories not listed here are reported as 'other: <category>'; 'aux' categories run overlapped on the aux stream and are shown but not summed. Draft-model (DSpark) segments are categories 'draft:<category>' and markers 'draft:<marker>' (layer id >= 1000 in the dump); the Petit MoE of a layer is the components 'MoE prep' + 'Petit Stage1/Stage2/Combine/post' (moe.experts .. petit.post, the whole kernel_moe_apply call), see step_breakdown.py share. 'moe.split' (tp4ep4-petit only) and 'moe.comm' (every layout whose MoE output is all-reduced after the MoE call: TP4 and tp4ep4-petit, not EP4/DP4-Petit). Where moe.comm fires, 'add/post-comm (TP4 all-reduce)' (moe.join->moe.comm) holds only the work before the collective (TP4: routed finalize + shared add; tp4ep4-petit: zero/copy of the shared partial and the add of the rank's routed rows, i.e. the row placement), and the all-reduce is the 'MoE output all-reduce' component; in dumps without moe.comm (an earlier instrumentation) add/post-comm still holds both. With a deferred (mHC-fused) all-reduce moe.comm does not fire and the collective runs in the next layer's pre-attention mHC. With TOKENSPEED_PETIT_FUSE_POST=1: the shared expert is issued before the routed call (shared.b/shared.e, aux stream under capture), moe.experts follows it, and the combine is 'Petit Combine wait for the shared expert (fused post)' + 'Petit Combine + shared add (fused post)' instead of 'Petit Combine'; the shared add is inside the combine, so 'add/post-comm' (moe.join->next) holds no add there. TOKENSPEED_PETIT_STAGE2_N128=1 keeps its 32x128 stage-2 kernel inside 'Petit Stage2 (down)' (petit.s2 brackets the launch whichever tile).

components.name: attn: compressor+KV write+indexer (main-stream part: fork gap + serial + after)
attn: q proj+rope (+join wait on aux compressor)
MoE row split (tp4ep4-petit: this rank's slice of the replicated rows, before routing)
MoE prep (EP: quant/prep; TP4: whole routed MoE)
Petit Combine wait for the shared expert (fused post: petit.cwait->petit.combr)
Petit Combine + shared add (fused post: residual combine)
MoE output all-reduce (moe.comm->ffn.end; TP4: routed+shared partials, tp4ep4-petit: combine/gather of the split rows)
DSpark draft: Petit MoE (moe.experts..petit.post of the instrumented stages)
DSpark draft: shared expert (serial on main stream)
DSpark draft: layer tail (ffn.end->next marker; holds the uninstrumented stages)
DSpark draft: tail (final norm, head, greedy block sampling, outputs)
